dataset_metadata.source: Personal itinerary with practical route details
dataset_metadata.privacy_note: This version includes accommodation addresses and richer location details per user request. Review before uploading to a public repository.

field_definitions.title: Short activity title
field_definitions.category: Activity type such as Food, Transport, Museum, Sightseeing, Event, Logistics, or Accommodation
field_definitions.location: Readable place, neighborhood, station, landmark, or route segment
field_definitions.address: Exact address when available; route pair for transport items; nearest useful area when exact address is not required
field_definitions.opening_booking_notes: Ticket, pass, opening-hour, reservation, or booking reminder
field_definitions.catch_up_eligibility: Whether the item can be moved to another slot if missed
field_definitions.can_skip: Whether the item can be skipped without damaging the route
field_definitions.food_options: Food stop options for meal/cafe rows, with addresses and recommended orders

general_notes: Use city cards mainly for local public transport first, and attraction discounts or free entries second.
Major Vienna attractions are usually not free with the Vienna City Card.
Salzburg Card and Innsbruck Card provide stronger attraction value than Vienna City Card.
Book timed attractions in advance where possible.
Check opening hours close to travel dates, especially Cafe Central renovation status, Salzwelten Hallstatt reopening, and Dachstein seasonal operation.
Keep cafe and coffee stops between 08:00 and 16:00.
Use accommodation areas as route anchors to avoid unnecessary transport interchanges.
For mountain days, check weather, cable car operation, and last descent times.
For Hallstatt and Obertraun, check evening transport and restaurant availability in advance.
Intercity trains are separate from city cards.
Carry some cash for traditional beer halls, mountain huts, and smaller village stops.
Use live transport apps for Hallstatt, Obertraun, and Dachstein connections.
verification_notes: Some addresses for smaller backup food options are marked as verify exact address before going because branches, openings, and names can change.
Cafe Central is a must-do target but has renovation uncertainty for autumn 2026; DECENTRAL is kept as the route-fit backup.
Demel, Cafe Central, Fenster Cafe, Austrian National Library State Hall, NENI Naschmarkt, Cafe Jelinek, and Votivkirche address/status details were cross-checked online during itinerary preparation.
